containers.name: gsbmymo
containers.description: GoAnywhere MFT drop location, shared across multiple DV source files (e.g. MYMO_LOAN, MYMO_DEPOSIT) -- not exclusive to dv_deposit_account.

containers.name: mymo_deposit
containers.description: Deposit account information for all MyMo-linked deposit accounts, monthly batch (T-3). File: MYMO_DEPOSIT_YYYYMMDD.TXT, HDT format (H=header with data date, D=detail rows, T=tail with row count), pipe-separated.

columns.name: row_type
columns.description: H (header), D (detail), or T (tail) -- HDT file format marker

columns.name: ending_balance
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string, e.g. 30000.000000

columns.name: account_group
columns.description: DDA, SAV, or CD. Source doc lists this column's type as Decimal, but the doc's own sample row ("CD") and processing logic (account_group="DDA" comparisons) show it's categorical -- corrected to STRING here, see draft notes.

columns.name: account_number
columns.description: PII -- hashed with MD5 downstream in the safe Hive table. Max length 12; >=11 if account_group != DDA.

columns.name: co_owner
columns.description: Comma-separated CIFs of joint-account co-owners, e.g. 22222,3333

columns.name: relationship_code
columns.description: A = single, B = or (any owner can act alone), C = and (all owners must act together)
